question: The term “double fault” is used in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tennis.**__

 
• Double fault means hitting a **fault on the second service**.
 
• Tennis or Lawn tennis is a racket sport that can be played individually or between two teams of two teams of two-player each.
 
• **International Tennis Federation: **
 
 
• It was founded on 1st March 1913.
 
• **​**It is a governing body of world tennis.
 
• Headquarters are located in **London, United Kingdom**.
 
• **David Haggerty** is the current president of ITF.
 
 
 
• **Grand Slam Tournament**
 
 
• Australia Open
 
• French Open
 
• Wimbledon
 
• US Open
